name: GitBackup
description: Pyrogram Telegram bot that backs up all GitHub repositories (every branch) as AES-256 encrypted ZIPs, uploaded to a Telegram channel on a schedule.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID — get it from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash — get it from https://my.telegram.org

CHANNEL_ID.description: Telegram channel where backups are sent — @username or -1001234567890 numeric ID. Bot must be an admin with Post Messages permission.

ADMINS.description: Space-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to run bot commands (e.g. 123456789 987654321). Get your ID from @userinfobot.

GITHUB_TOKENS.description: Space-separated GitHub Personal Access Tokens — one per account. Needs repo + read:user scopes.

GITHUB_USERNAMES.description: Space-separated GitHub usernames matching the order of GITHUB_TOKENS.

ZIP_PASSWORD.description: AES-256 password for the encrypted ZIP archives.

BACKUP_RANGE.description: Backup schedule frequency. Accepted values: daily (00:00 IST), weekly (Monday 00:00 IST), monthly (1st of month 00:00 IST).

MAX_UPLOAD_MB.description: Maximum Telegram upload part size in MB. Archives larger than this are split into numbered parts.
